high_level_description: The image is a detailed chart titled "Red moon rising," which focuses on the share of high-quality science papers by author location across selected countries/regions. The chart is divided into two main sections: Top Section: Share of Global High-Impact Papers This section shows the percentage of global high-impact papers published by authors from the United States, the European Union, and China. The x-axis represents the year of publication, ranging from 2003 to 2022. The y-axis represents the share of global high-impact papers as a percentage.
